ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a secondary distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at a 5:1 ratio across the visible surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe, oriented roughly 45 degrees relative to the median notch axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent notch and irregular hooking at the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a secondary fluke or fin structure in the lower right foreground of the pixel array.
